items.name: Maron's wine, drunk neat
items.note: Maron himself mixed twenty parts of water to one of this wine (b-wine); Polyphemus drains three bowls of it unmixed (b-three-bowls). Each bowl is about twenty servings of the drink Maron served. Estimate: -10 on the Endurance resist roll (-50%), enough that even a strong drinker is likely to pass out. The docs have no drink rule; the number is an estimate.

needs.text: Ulysses and his crew are men
a one-eyed giant who eats men
hides under a ram past a searching hand
heaven fills the men with courage, for the moment

endurance.note: a giant's body; still passes out

willpower.note: ordinary men about to turn faint-hearted

beats.quote: when he drank it he mixed twenty parts of water to one of wine, and yet the fragrance from the mixing-bowl was so exquisite that it was impossible to refrain from drinking.
beats.summary: Why the wine is so strong.

beats.quote: Then he rolled a huge stone to the mouth of the cave—so huge that two and twenty strong four-wheeled waggons would not be enough to draw it from its place against the doorway.

checks.note: Twenty-two waggons cannot move it; read as about 20 t.

beats.quote: he sat down and milked his ewes and goats, all in due course
with a sudden clutch he gripped up two of my men at once and dashed them down upon the ground as though they had been puppies.
lastly I brought it to a point myself, charring the end in the fire to make it harder.
my name is Noman; this is what my father and mother and my friends have always called me.
three times did I fill the bowl for him, and three times did he drain it without thought or heed
As he spoke he reeled, and fell sprawling face upwards on the ground.
my men gathered round me, for heaven had filled their hearts with courage.
We drove the sharp end of the beam into the monster's eye
beats.summary: He is asleep: no defense roll.

beats.quote: I caught hold of him by the back, esconced myself in the thick wool under his belly
he tore the top from off a high mountain, and flung it just in front of my ship

checks.note: A mountain top; read as about 1,000 t.

beats.quote: say it was the valiant warrior Ulysses, son of Laertes, who lives in Ithaca.
